name: CoA summons without live area-of-effect avoidance wear Pet Avoidance
contract: Design choice by the maintainer (2026-10-09), not live parity: in live CoA combat logs (2026-05) these summons took as much area damage as the players hit by the same cast, and the maintainer chose to protect them like the stock guardians. 32233 'Pet Avoidance' (aura 310 -90% creature area damage, aura 229 -20%) is the avoidance Guardian::InitStatsForLevel gives the stock guardians. Summons: 13049 'Dragon's Call' -> 8776 Emerald Dragon Whelp, 6251 'Summon Crimson Cannon' -> 11199 Crimson Cannon, 26066 'Defender of the Timbermaw' -> 15720 Timbermaw Ancestor, 504344 'Fungal Assailant' -> 45896 Fungarian (guardians) and 804834 'Ancestor's Call' -> 51265 Honored Ancestor (SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON_PET). 525379 'Animate: Zombie' -> 503031 Zombie needs a corpse and is covered by the same entry list without a step here. 706756 'Chains of Xoroth' -> 51323 is left out: its script makes it non-attackable, so area damage cannot reach it. Expected: each summon wears 32233. Before the change none of them did.
